author: fresh S009-specific author/illustrator
central_comic_situation: An unsolicited commander organizes dogs who chiefly want shade, food and friendship.

wants.Neet: Recognition, security and a place with the local dogs; believes authority earns belonging.
wants.Buddy: Shade and peaceful company; tries diplomacy and fair food sharing.
wants.collision: Neet issues assignments that would prevent Buddy and the others from enjoying the very place he is protecting.

preserved_incidents: Heather walking the dogs in Ahmedabad
strong_existing_lines: Only Neet could turn a casual walk into a military operation.
actual_changes: Invader rolling over undercuts war declaration.
Neet notices shade he has declared war against.
Heather retrieves leash and measures achievement as crossing the street.
Terrier opens both eyes at food.
Buddy chooses rest and gives dusk report joke.
White dog returns from patrol because shade moved.
Buddy failed food queue gives him a comic attempt and practical correction.
Retriever friendly response outlasts Neet severity.
Everyone may rest permission arrives after everyone is resting.
ending: Neet accepts the shared shade then gives unnecessary permission to rest. Belonging survives his self-importance.

variant_decisions.decision: Read fully; reverse-order duplicate, no distinct incident or meaningful alternative to invent or separately illustrate.

complete_reread_comparison.method: Read full original, complete previous working edition, connected S010-S012 and whole revised narrative in order; compare retained incident chain and ending.
complete_reread_comparison.lost_incidents: None in original founding sequence. Prior refinement already replaced passive awe/final generic declaration with Buddy choices and Shadow making room; retained.
complete_reread_comparison.voices: Preserved third-person and theatrical interpreted dog speech; small direct dialogue follows existing dogs-talk convention. Heather dry and practical; no Sagar inserted into historical household.
complete_reread_comparison.humor: Added physical noncompliance, one Buddy mistake, a human response and final callback; retained successful understated greetings.
complete_reread_comparison.expansion: Targeted brief beats only; no new subplot. Length chosen from short historical story, not padded to guideline target.
complete_reread_comparison.meaning: No new rank, chronology, calibrated size, breed or visual canon asserted. Historical Chihuahua prose remains draft wording, not anatomical authority.

art_plan.anchor: The lanky white dog walked to the north wall, discovered that its shade had moved, and walked back. Neet watched this first patrol return with impressive speed.
art_plan.contribution: High commander against resting listeners; first patrol already back.

art_plan.anchor: The retriever wagged at him too. Neet held his severe expression a moment longer, in case it was still required.
art_plan.contribution: Retain nose greeting and independent severe Neet; smooth short coats.
Empty command rock behind now-resting Neet; belonging and unnecessary permission payoff.

image_correction_note: Only image targets updated after independent coat findings; narrative prose unchanged.
